aboutStory.paragraph1: 喜马拉雅雪巴灵酒店坐落于加德满都塔梅尔的中心，融合文化魅力、舒适与便利，是国内外游客探索尼泊尔奇观的理想选择。

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our rooms, location in Thamel, airport pickups, and hospitality services.
faq.helpTitle: Still have questions about your stay?
faq.helpSubtitle: Our warm Sherpa team is always ready to assist with customized itineraries, special requests, and room bookings.
faq.q1: Where is Hotel Sherpa Soul located in Kathmandu?
faq.a1: Hotel Sherpa Soul is situated on Thamel Bhagawati Marg 26 in the heart of Thamel, Kathmandu, Nepal. We are within walking distance to famous restaurants, shops, and cultural heritage sites, and approximately 6 km from Tribhuvan International Airport.
faq.q2: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a2: Check-in begins at 14:00 (2:00 PM) and check-out is until 12:00 (12:00 PM). Our front desk is open 24/7, and flexible early check-in or late check-out is available upon request subject to room availability.
faq.q3: Do you offer airport pickup and shuttle services?
faq.a3: Yes, we provide reliable airport pickup and drop-off transfers between Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM) and the hotel. You can request a transfer during direct booking or by contacting us via WhatsApp at +977-9851068219.
faq.q4: Is high-speed Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel?
faq.a4: Yes, complimentary high-speed fiber-optic Wi-Fi is available in all guest rooms, suites, the rooftop terrace, and common areas, perfect for remote workers and travelers staying connected.
faq.q5: Is there a kitchen facility for guests to use?
faq.a5: 是的，Hotel Sherpa Soul 提供设备齐全的自助共享厨房，严格仅供登记的长住客人（按周或按月入住）使用。短途单晚住宿不提供厨房使用。
faq.q6: Can you arrange trekking permits and Himalayan tours?
faq.a6: Absolutely! Drawing from our authentic Sherpa mountain heritage, our team provides complete travel desk support including Everest, Annapurna, and Langtang trek permits, licensed Sherpa guides, domestic flights, and valley sightseeing.
faq.q7: Can I securely store my luggage while on a trek?
faq.a7: Yes, we offer complimentary secure luggage storage before check-in, after check-out, and for trekkers during their multi-day Himalayan journeys until they return.
faq.q8: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a8: We accept cash (NPR, USD, EUR), credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard), Fonepay QR transfers, and direct bank transfers.
